item.title: About
item.description:
Hi, my name Yuval. I like to create software for people (not to maximize some arbitrary KPI, but rather a human centered need).

When I am not in front of the computer you can find me enjoyig spending time with the people I care about the most, and also trying to find peace in solitraty activities when I can (music, reading, etc.).

I enjoy meeting new people, so don’t be afraid to send (note, I still havn’t set the inbox. this comment will be removed when I’ve done so) an email: yuvalbloginbox (at) pm dot me.

item.title: My AI Usage Philosophy
item.description:
I remember the first time I got introduced to LLMs (pre-agent explosion). It was during a short stint at a tiny social startup. My mentor / boss was seriously into AI and true believer. After many a task where I refused to use AI, I gave it a shot and was blown away.

It wasn’t all knowing, but it helped me locate all the stupid simple mistakes I made in a code block. I still had to do the legwork to narrow dowm the buggy code, so it felt like a good comprimise between thinking/doing and outsourcing.

item.title: Qubes Os Adventures
item.description: I must confess, as much as I would like to say I chose QubesOS for its security features, that would be a lie. I love putting things into boxes and this seems like the perfect opportunity to do so. I tried to do something similar to QubesOS but with vanilla VMs, but the lack of proper integration with the broader OS made it so much more of a headache than it needed to be.
